games.name: Armatus
games.short_description: 《阿瑪塔斯》是一款第三人稱 roguelite 射擊遊戲，故事背景是已淪為廢墟，群魔橫行的巴黎。化身古老教團唯一倖存的異能戰士，手握強大火器與超凡的神賜之力，踏遍城市每個角落，尋找通向天堂的隱秘門戶：無光之門。

games.short_description_en: ARMATUS is a third-person roguelite shooter set in the demon-infested ruins of Paris. As the last supernatural warrior of an ancient order, armed with powerful firearms and incredible celestial powers, scour the city in search of a lost gateway to heaven - the Sunless Gate.

games.name: Ember and Blade
games.short_description: 化作不死身的獵手，對抗魔王阿斯莫戴。衝破洶湧魔潮，激戰魂系勁敵，駕馭天賜祝福，輪迴之力不息。惡魔敵眾正在蠢蠢欲動——舉起你的劍來。
games.short_description_en: Become the immortal hunter and stand against the archdemon Asmodeus. Cut through bullet-hell swarms, clash with Souls-like bosses, and harness celestial blessings that reshape your powers each run. The demons are rising—raise your sword.

games.name: Danganronpa 2x2
games.short_description: 造訪賈巴沃克島的學生們，因為黑白熊的陰謀而被迫進行自相殘殺，不得不展開班級審判以找出犯人。駁倒對方發言中的矛盾，在高速推理動作遊戲中揭穿殺人事件的真相！同步收錄全新故事與原作劇情的雙份體驗！
games.short_description_en: While on a school trip to Jabberwock Island, students are ensnared in Monokuma’s deadly game, forced into mutual killing and Class Trials to expose the culprit. Break through contradictions with high-speed detective action. Includes both a brand-new scenario and the enhanced original!

games.name: STRANGER THAN HEAVEN
games.short_description: 這是一個關於沒有容身之處的男人們，歷經50年為了追求歸所而戰的故事。 透過5個時代與5座城市來描繪動盪的近代日本。 可遊玩逼真血腥幹架的戰鬥系統以及經營秀場生意，享受身為「經紀人」的成功故事。 由「人中之龍工作室」出品的戲劇冒險最新力作。

games.short_description_en: A fifty-year, action-adventure saga of men with nowhere to go and their desperate struggle to find a home. Use extreme violence to survive, and musical talent to thrive as a showman across five cities and eras of modern Japan.

games.name: ANANTA
games.short_description: 《無限大》是一款都市題材開放世界RPG。你將扮演不同角色，從重霄到新啟，穿梭於繁華街頭和隱秘角落，漫步在茶山古鎮與老城巷陌。在不同城市間探索，結識各具魅力的夥伴，建立自己的專屬團隊。

games.short_description_en: Welcome to ANANTA, an Urban Open World RPG. Play as a variety of characters and explore everything from bustling business districts and hidden alleyways, to quiet tea towns and buzzing old streets. Rub shoulders with a wide-ranging cast of intriguing characters as you assemble a team all your own.

games.name: TankRat
games.short_description: 在一個瀕死的世界，血肉被鋼鐵所取代。成群的機械怪獸在荒野之中遊蕩。搜索並摧毀、拾荒並拆解，在殘骸之中重建自己。你奪取的東西，就會成為你的樣子。在荒野中生存，前往 Highpoint。

games.short_description_en: A dying world, flesh given way to steel. Swarms of corrupted mech-monsters roam a desolated land. Search and destroy, scavenge and dismantle, rebuild yourself from the wreckage. What you take becomes what you are. Survive the wasteland. Make it to Highpoint.

games.name: 13Z: The Zodiac Trials
games.short_description: 你的目標是成為第十三位生肖！接受勇氣、速度與力量的終極試煉，體驗酣暢淋漓的動作Roguelite冒險之旅！
games.short_description_en: Go solo or team up with up to three friends in online co-op for this fast-paced, anime-inspired action roguelike. Master stylish hack and slash combat, craft overpowered builds, and conquer mythological trials to claim the title of the thirteenth Zodiac.
